question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Glorify
solution:
The correct answer is "**Celebrate**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Glorify" means ****to praise or honor someone or something.**(महिमामंडन)

 
 
• ​Example: The good thing is that he does not glorify violence.
 
 
 
• ​**"Celebrate" means ****to honor or praise someone or something publicly**.(जश्न मनाना)
 
 
• Example: The town will celebrate the hero who saved the child from drowning.
 
 
 
 
 
• ​Thus, it is clear that the word "celebrate" is the synonym of the word "glorify."

Hence,** the correct answer is option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, Lower, means to decrease or make something less. (निचला)
 
• Option 2, Wonder, means to be curious or amazed about something.(आश्चर्य)
 
• Option 4, Mock, means to ridicule or make fun of someone or something.(दिखावटी)
